page.overview:
Who is Bobby Ball?

Robert K. "Bobby" Ball (August 26, 1925, Phoenix, Arizona – February 27, 1954, Phoenix) was a United States race driver. He ran in the Indianapolis 500 twice, recording a fifth place in his first 500 in .

In early 1953, Ball was running in a sprint car race in Los Angeles when he suffered severe head injuries in an accident. He remained in a coma for 14 months, before dying of an infection.
